title: Illustrative offset traversal work
method: Synthetic page size 50. Offset zero produces 50 positions; offset 9,000 produces/skips 9,000 then returns 50 = 9,050. Counts are conceptual query work, not physical reads or latency; plan and filtering costs are excluded.
alt: Illustrative offset traversal work. First page: 50 result positions; After offset 9000: 9050 result positions. Illustrative inputs.
